title: Cylinder
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector of [0.005, 0.005, 0.69]. On the first face, draw a single circle with its center at coordinates [0.025, 0.025] and a radius of 0.025. Scale this circle by a factor of 0.05 to reduce its size proportionally. Rotate the scaled circle using the same Euler angles as the coordinate system and translate it using the same vector. Extrude the scaled and transformed circle along the normal direction by 0.06 units to form a cylindrical solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. The final dimensions of the cylinder will be a length of 0.05 units, a width of 0.05 units, and a height of 0.06 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the center and radius of the circle
center = (0.025, 0.025)
radius = 0.025

# Create a circle in the XY plane
r = r.center(*center).circle(radius)

# Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
extrude_depth = 0.06
r = r.extrude(extrude_depth)

# Apply the translation vector
translation_vector = (0.005, 0.005, 0.69)
r = r.translate(translation_vector)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
translation_vector = (0.0, 0.0, 0.06)
euler_angles = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.025, 0.025).circle(0.025)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.06)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
cylinder = cylinder.translate(translation_vector).rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), euler_angles[0]) \
                         .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), euler_angles[1]) \
                         .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), euler_angles[2])

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
